name: Situation_Zille_Frontline_Offensive
title: Wojna o Odzyskanie Prowincji Zille
description: Siły zbrojne Królestwa Rizii prowadzą pełnoskalową operację lądowo-morską mającą na celu wyzwolenie prowincji Zille spod okupacji Wehlen.

name: Diplomacy_Agnolia_Agriculture_Market_Access
title: Agnolia Priority in Agriculture Market
description: Agnolia has been granted a special privilege in Sordland - they have priority access and are entitled to purchase any agricultural product that has been produced within the country's borders. Additionally, Agnolians will receive a discount on the tariffs that are applied to these purchases.

name: Diplomacy_Agnolia_CheapSteelPrice
title: Cheaper Price Steel Imports From Agnolia
description: Sordland has entered into a favorable trade agreement with Agnolia to import steel at a reduced price. Compared to other countries, Sordland pays only half the cost for the same amount of steel imported from Agnolia.

name: Diplomacy_Agnolia_HighSteelPrice
title: Higher Price Steel Imports from Agnolia
description: Sordland imports steel from Agnolia at twice the cost compared to other countries. However, this trade agreement provides Sordland with access to high-quality steel from a reliable source and supports the ongoing trade relations between the two nations.

name: Diplomacy_AN_ANDORArbitration
title: ANDOR Aureus Arbitration Procedure
description:
The ANDOR (Alliance of Nations Directive on Offshore Resources) Aureus Arbitration Procedure is in effect to resolve the dispute over the Aureus Gas Field, contested by Rizia and Pales. 

This procedure, under the 1942 AN Directive, aims for a fair allocation of resources, balancing sovereign rights and international law to achieve an equitable solution.

name: Diplomacy_ANSanctions_Heavy
title: Heavy AN Sanctions
description: The Alliance of Nations imposes heavy sanctions on the nation, significantly impacting its global trade and diplomatic relations. This severe measure, resulting from contentious international issues, necessitates urgent diplomatic efforts to mitigate its effects and restore global standing.

name: Diplomacy_ANSanctions_Weak
title: Weak AN Sanctions
description: The Alliance of Nations enforces moderate sanctions, reflecting a tepid response to the nation's actions on the international stage. While not critically damaging, these sanctions signal a need for careful diplomatic navigation to avoid further repercussions.

name: Diplomacy_AN_ThreatMitigationProtocol
title: AN Threat Mitigation Protocol
description:
The AN Threat Mitigation Protocol is being employed by Wehlen to legitimize an extension of the Zille Agreement of 1927, resulting in the region remaining under Wehzek control until the present security threat is deemed to be over.

This protocol, reserved for critical scenarios, reflects the gravity of the situation in the wake of the Friendship Day bomb attack.

name: Diplomacy_ArcasiaAid
title: Arcasian Aid
description: As part of Arcasia's considerable aid package to Sordland, including financial, logistical, and equipment support, they will gain occasional flyover rights and refueling access at Erlory Air Force Base. This aid is aimed at enhancing Sordland's infrastructure and advancing development. The agreement is indicative of President Rayne's strategy to strengthen ties with Arcasia, potentially leading to broader alignments within the Arcasia Treaty Organization.

name: Diplomacy_Arcasia_Military_Influence
title: Arcasian Military Influence
description: As required by our entry into the ATO, their liaison officers will work closely alongside the Sordish Command Staff, which includes the heads of our Army, Navy and Air Force to assist in the integration process of the Sordish Armed Forces into the unified ATO military structure.

name: Diplomacy_Arcasia_Military_Support
title: ATO Military Support
description: As per their treaty obligations the ATO is providing the Sordish Armed Forces new military equipment, assistance in unifying our military logistics, and providing new training techniques to all SAF branches.

name: Diplomacy_ArcasianInfluence
title: Arcasian Influence
description: Arcasia, a superpower in the region, has brought Sordland under its sphere of influence. This strategic move reflects Arcasia's growing influence and demonstrates its ability to shape the political landscape of the region.

name: Diplomacy_ArcasiaTradeHalt
title: Embargoed by Arcasia
description: Arcasia has imposed an embargo on all goods originating from Sordland. This move is likely to have a significant impact on Sordland's economy, which relies heavily on trade with its neighbors.

name: Diplomacy_Contana_Military_Support
title: Contanan Military Support
description: As required by our entry into the CSP, their liaison officers will work closely alongside the Sordish Command Staff, which includes the heads of our Army, Navy and Air Force to assist in the integration process of the Sordish Armed Forces into the unified CSP military structure.

name: Diplomacy_Contana_Missile_Duru_Island
title: Contana Missile Defense System
description: As a condition of our entry into the CSP, United Contana has committed to building its Missile Defense System on Duru Island. This strategic move will provide crucial protection against potential missile attacks and strengthen our national security.

name: Diplomacy_ContananInfluence
title: Contanan Influence
description: As a superpower in the region, United Contana has brought Sordland under its sphere of influence. This strategic move reflects United Contana's growing power and influence and demonstrates its ability to shape the political landscape of the region.

name: Diplomacy_CulturalProjection_Inconsequential
title: Inconsequential Cultural Projection
description: Efforts to spread Rizian culture and heritage have minimal impact beyond our kingdom's borders. Despite attempts at cultural outreach, initiatives such as the Ariana Toras Association struggle to leave a significant mark abroad, reflecting a need for more effective soft power strategies.

name: Diplomacy_CulturalProjection_Influential
title: Influential Cultural Projection
description: Rizia's cultural projection, led by the Ariana Toras Association, significantly influences neighboring nations and beyond. The rich heritage and values of Rizia resonate across the former Rezenid empire, showcasing effective use of soft power in regional diplomacy.

name: Diplomacy_CulturalProjection_Regional
title: Regional Cultural Projection
description: Through the Ariana Toras Association and Su Omina, Rizia actively spreads its rich heritage and culture in the region, leaving a mark on neighboring nations and beyond. The value of Rizian culture spreads across former Rezenid nations which are profoundly influenced by these cultural outreach programs.

name: Diplomacy_Derdia_GasExport
title: Gas Energy Exports to Derdia
description: A surge in new gas energy exports to Derdia is strengthening economic ties and energy diplomacy. This increase in trade not only bolsters the nation's economy but also enhances our strategic energy partnership with Derdia.

name: Diplomacy_Derdia_OilExport
title: Oil Energy Exports to Derdia
description: Oil energy exports to Derdia see a notable rise, solidifying the economic bond between the two nations. This growth in oil trade contributes significantly to Rizia's energy sector and its geopolitical relations with Derdia.

name: Diplomacy_DiplomaticPressure
title: Diplomatic Pressure
description: Sordland is facing noticeable pressure from Rumburg, demonstrated by the reduction of diplomatic staff and the closure of a key consulate. This development is expected to significantly impact Sordland's diplomatic relations with Rumburg, potentially leading to a further deterioration.

name: Diplomacy_Energy_ForeignInfluence
title: Foreign Energy Influence
description: Sordland is experiencing a moderate level of foreign influence within its energy sector, creating certain challenges in maintaining control over domestic energy policies and decision-making.

name: Diplomacy_Energy_ForeignManipulation
title: Foreign Energy Manipulation
description: There is a high degree of foreign manipulation in Sordland's energy sector, threatening the country's energy stability and raising significant concerns about national security and sovereignty.

name: Diplomacy_Energy_Independence
title: Energy Independence
description: Sordland has achieved significant strides towards energy independence, demonstrating a low severity level of reliance on foreign sources. The country's substantial self-sufficiency in energy production ensures stability and minimal external threat influences.

name: Diplomacy_Energy_PriceBalanced
title: Balanced Energy Prices
description: Sordland is currently enjoying a period of balanced energy prices, reflecting stability in both supply and demand within the sector. This equilibrium has the potential to contribute positively to the economy, fostering a conducive environment for steady growth and sustainable economic planning.

name: Diplomacy_Energy_PriceFluctuation
title: Fluctuating Energy Prices
description: Sordland is currently grappling with fluctuating energy prices, a development causing uncertainty in the domestic market. This unpredictability may lead to significant repercussions for Sordland's economy and can influence both domestic policy and international trade relations.

name: Diplomacy_Energy_PriceSurge
title: Surging Energy Prices
description: Sordland is witnessing a surge in energy prices, a development likely to strain the economy and potentially raise the cost of living for Sordish citizens. The escalating energy prices may lead to socio-economic challenges and could instigate policy changes to mitigate the impact on consumers and the broader economy.

name: Diplomacy_ExperiencedDiplomats
title: Experienced Diplomats
description: The Diplomatic Corps of Sordland has a well-earned reputation for excellence, having educated some of the finest diplomats who have excelled in their field over the past century.

name: Diplomacy_FailedTradeNegotiation
title: Failed Trade Negotiation
description: The recent attempt to sign a significant trade deal has failed, resulting in a negative mood among Sordland's trade negotiators and policymakers. The failure of the deal may have far-reaching consequences, including potential economic impacts and damage to Sordland's reputation as a reliable trade partner.

name: Diplomacy_FTZLespia
title: Free Trade Zone with Lespia
description: The creation of a comprehensive free trade zone with Lespia has strengthened economic bonds between the two nations and improved their overall relationship. The establishment of this free trade zone will help to increase trade volume and promote greater economic cooperation between Sordland and Lespia.

name: Diplomacy_FTZValgsland
title: Free Trade Zone with Valgsland
description: The creation of a comprehensive free trade zone with Valgsland has strengthened economic bonds between the two nations and improved their overall relationship. The establishment of this free trade zone will help to increase trade volume and promote greater economic cooperation between Sordland and Valgsland.

name: Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad
title: Bad Global Image
description:
The nation currently faces a significant challenge with its deteriorating global image. International perceptions have been negatively impacted by controversial policies, diplomatic missteps, or perceived aggression in foreign affairs. This unfavorable view hampers Rizia's diplomatic efforts, complicates international relations, and could potentially lead to isolation or sanctions. 

The situation calls for a strategic reevaluation of Rizia's external policies and actions to rebuild its reputation and restore its standing in the global community.

name: Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Good
title: Exceptional Global Image
description:
The global image of the Golden Kingdom has reached an exceptional level, marked by widespread international acclaim and respect. This favorable perception is a result of successful diplomatic initiatives, humanitarian efforts, and a commitment to global peace and stability. 

Rizia's positive influence in international affairs has not only enhanced its reputation but also solidified its position as a key player on the world stage, fostering beneficial alliances and partnerships.

name: Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Mixed
title: Mixed Global Image
description:
The global image of the country presents a complex mix of positive and negative perceptions. While certain aspects of its foreign policy and international conduct have been lauded, other actions or decisions have drawn criticism or skepticism. This mixed reputation affects Rizia's diplomatic leverage and necessitates a nuanced approach to international relations. 

Balancing these perceptions is crucial for the nation to maintain its influence and effectively navigate the complexities of the global diplomatic landscape.

name: Diplomacy_GlobalInfluence_ATO
title: ATO Influence
description: The presence of the Arcasian Treaty Organisation subtly weaves into the economic, diplomatic, and cultural fabric. While not overtly dominant, the ATO's influence subtly guides policies and public sentiment, shaping a nuanced and strategic narrative within national circles.

name: Diplomacy_GlobalInfluence_CSP
title: CSP Influence
description: The Contanan Security Pact exerts a quiet yet palpable influence, infiltrating economic and cultural spheres in a less conspicuous manner. This gentle sway impacts decision-making and public perception, reflecting a tactful blend of ideological and strategic undertones in various aspects of life.

name: Diplomacy_GlobalMonarchistSupportNetwork
title: Global Monarchist Support Network
description: GRACE is fervently bolstering monarchies worldwide, casting a global spotlight on Rizia. Monarchist traditions flourish as this network battles growing republic sentiments, uniting monarchies under a shared banner. Rizia, in the heart of this movement, gains significant diplomatic clout.

name: Diplomacy_GlobalRivalry_Encroaching
title: Encroaching Global Rivalry
description: The country finds itself in a precarious geopolitical situation as the borders of the two global superpowers inch closer. The Arcasian Treaty Alliance, led by the superpower Arcasia, and the Contanan Security Pact, with United Contana at its helm as the Malenyevist socialist superpower, are both expanding their influence, bringing their rivalry to Rizia's doorstep.

name: Diplomacy_InfluentialOMECMember
title: Influential OMEC Member
description: Sordland is a key member of the founding members of OMEC as many of its economic experts have Sordish descent. The contribution of Sordland's economic experts has been crucial in the establishment and development of OMEC as a prominent economic organization.

name: Diplomacy_LackOfAllies
title: Lack of Allies
description: Sordland's independence and prominent role on the international stage are not fully secured as it lacks strong allies. Without the support of reliable allies, Sordland may struggle to assert its interests and maintain its position in the global arena.

name: Diplomacy_Lespia_Aureus25Percent
title: Aureus 25 Percent Deal
description: We secured a 25 percent stake in the Aureus Gas Field through a landmark agreement with Lespia. This deal fortifies trade relations with our northern neighbor while providing a consistent if moderate boost to our energy reserves.

name: Diplomacy_Lespia_Coal_Trade
title: Coal Trade with Lespia
description: Lespia has become Sordland's leading export trading partner of coal from Lorren due to the favorable environment created by the agreement.

name: Diplomacy_Lespia_Fish_Trade
title: Fish Trade with Lespia
description: Sordland's comprehensive agreement with Lespia has reduced regulations and barriers, resulting in Lespia becoming Sordland's leading export trading partner of fish from Agnland. The agreement has created a more favorable trading environment, boosting trade volume and promoting economic cooperation.

name: Diplomacy_Lespia_SordishPetroleum
title: Sordish Petroleum Sold to Lespia
description: Sordland has sold Sordish Petroleum to Lespia as per the agreement between the two nations. Sordish Petroleum owns most of the oil trade in Sordland, and the sale means that Lespia will now redirect most of the oil from Wehlen to themselves.

name: Diplomacy_LespiaTradeTariffs
title: Trade Tariffs by Lespia
description: Lespia has imposed damaging tariffs on Sordland's most important traded goods, causing significant economic harm. The imposition of tariffs has resulted in a negative impact on Sordland's economy and the trade relationship between the two nations.

name: Diplomacy_Lespia_Tungsten_Trade
title: Tungsten Trade with Lespia
description: The comprehensive agreement between Sordland and Lespia to reduce regulations and barriers has made Lespia Sordland's leading export trading partner of tungsten. The agreement has created a more favorable environment for trade, boosting economic cooperation and trade volume between the two nations.

name: Diplomacy_Lespia_Wheat_Trade
title: Wheat Trade with Lespia
description: The comprehensive agreement between Sordland and Lespia to reduce regulations and barriers has enabled Lespia to become Sordland's leading export trading partner of wheat from Bergia.

name: Diplomacy_MITZ_InconsequentialMember
title: Inconsequential MITZ Member
description: Rizia's role in the stewardship of the Meftiem International Trade Zone has significantly lessened as a result of the amended MITZ agreement. We now have less of a say in the governance of the region and a smaller claim to the resources extracted from it.

name: Diplomacy_MITZ_Influential
title: Influential MITZ Member
description: As a Board Member Nation in the Meftiem International Trade Zone, Rizia has a significant influence in guiding the mining operations of the gold-rich Meftiem basin. This prominent role in the cooperative also grants the nation a larger share of the region's resources.

name: Diplomacy_MITZ_KeyMember
title: Key MITZ Member
description: Rizia is a crucial Board Member Nation of the Meftiem International Trade Zone, founded in 1916 in Morella. This cooperative, rich in gold resources from the Meftiem basin, oversees mining facilities and the jointly-owned Muardien Port. Rizia's stake, vital for the zone's success, expanded significantly after its alliance with Rumburg post the loss of Zille.

name: Diplomacy_Morella_GasExport
title: Morella Gas Exports
description: The strategic escalation in gas exports to Morella signifies a robust economic diplomacy initiative between Rizia and its western neighbor. This surge in trade amplifies the nation's influence in both regional and international energy dialogues, enhancing geopolitical leverage and fostering mutual economic benefits.

name: Diplomacy_Morella_OilExport
title: Morella Oil Exports
description:
The notable increase in oil exports to Morella marks a significant stride in energy diplomacy and economic engagement. This expansion reflects a strategic maneuver in the international oil market, reinforcing the nation's status as a pivotal energy supplier. 

The burgeoning oil trade deepens economic ties, offering a platform for broader bilateral cooperation and reinforcing geopolitical alliances.

name: Diplomacy_Pales_ATAFunded
title: ATA Operations in Pales
description: The Ariana Toras Association is active in Pales and is enhancing our soft power projection and influence among the people. This improves the image of our culture among the locals.

name: Diplomacy_Pales_SuOminaActive
title: Su Omina: Suppress Uprising
description: As the occupation of Palesian cities deepens, Su Omina has been deployed to crush any signs of dissent. Their orders are clear: suppress uprisings, dismantle resistance networks, and ensure Rizian control remains unchallenged.

name: Diplomacy_Pales_War
title: State of War with Grand Duchy of Pales
description:
The declaration of war against the Grand Duchy of Pales propels the nation into full-scale military engagement, at the risk of diplomatic isolation. 

The conflict disrupts the regional balance of power, forcing immediate strategic shifts and aggressive military positioning. Success on the warfront depends on coordinated combat operations and sharp diplomatic maneuvering to protect national interests.

name: Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Average
title: Average Power Projection
description: The nation's power projection on the international stage is tangible yet constrained. This average level of influence manifests in moderated diplomatic negotiations and military posturing, reflecting a need for enhanced defense strategies.

name: Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming
title: Overwhelming Power Projection
description:
The nation exerts an overwhelming amount of power and influence beyond its borders, signifying a very dominant position in international affairs. This strong influence is leveraged in diplomatic engagements, military alliances, and economic negotiations. 

This assertive stance not only consolidates our global standing but also serves as a massive deterrent, forcing international partners into appeasement policies.

name: Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong
title: Strong Power Projection
description:
The nation's adept power projection capabilities signify a dominant position in international affairs. This strong influence is leveraged in diplomatic engagements, military alliances, and economic negotiations. 

The assertive stance not only consolidates our global standing but also serves as a deterrent, preventing hostilities from international actors.

name: Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak
title: Weak Power Projection
description: Despite its regional significance and strategic assets, Rizia struggles with showcasing its power and influence beyond its borders. This limited ability to project strength internationally has implications for diplomatic negotiations, military posturing, and economic leverage.

name: Diplomacy_RumburgAggression
title: Rumburg Expansionism
description: The expansionist doctrine of Rumburg over the last century has led to a highly volatile situation on the Merkopa continent. Rumburg's actions have contributed to increased tensions and instability in the region, with potential negative consequences for neighboring nations like Sordland.

name: Diplomacy_RumburgAverageEnergyExports
title: Rumburg Average Energy Exports
description: The ongoing gas agreement with Rumburg maintains a steady export rate, aligning perfectly with market conditions and infrastructural capacities. This consistent energy trade not only strengthens Rizia's ties with its distant, historic ally Rumburg but also reinforces its influential position within the GRACE network.

name: Diplomacy_Rumburg_GasPipeline
title: Rumburg-Sordland Gas Trade
description: Rumburg has extended the Sordish natural gas pipeline to its territory, significantly amplifying bilateral trade. The agreement is uniquely forged at 30% cheaper than Sordland's agreements with other neighbors.

name: Diplomacy_RumburgHighEnergyExports
title: Rumburg High Energy Exports
description: Under the latest terms of the gas trade agreement with Rumburg, export volumes have notably increased. While this robust energy exchange enhances Rizia's standing within the GRACE network and tightens its bond with Rumburg, it places additional pressure on Rizia's domestic energy reserves and production capabilities.

name: Diplomacy_RumburgInvasion
title: Rumburg Invasion
description: What began as a small border incident has now escalated into a full invasion by Rumburg forces, with clashes currently taking place along the northern border of Sordland. The situation is highly volatile and has the potential to lead to further conflict and instability in the region.

name: Diplomacy_Rumburg_KA74License
title: Rumburg Licenses KA-74
description: Rumburg has granted Sordland licenses to produce its own variant of the KA-74. This development bolsters Sordland's national defense, promises considerable long-term economic benefits, and symbolizes improved relations.

name: Diplomacy_Rumburg_SellPortOfMonqiz
title: Port of Monqiz sold to Rumburg
description: The kingdom has finalized the sale of the Port of Monqiz to Rumburg, in return securing the ongoing support from one of the most powerful members of GRACE. While the deal strengthens the kingdom's military capacity and relationship to their ally, the long-term loss of a major coastal asset has raised concerns among economic advisors and naval officials.

name: Diplomacy_Rumburg_Suzerain
title: Rumburg Suzerain
description:
The overwhelming influence of Rumburg casts a shadow over national sovereignty, with the GRACE alliance further intensifying this suzerainty. This dominance manifests in various sectors, subtly undermining independent statecraft and limiting diplomatic and economic autonomy. 

The pervasive Rumburgian presence raises concerns about the true extent of Rizia's independence and the ability to pursue an autonomous foreign policy.

name: Diplomacy_Shipping_Disruptions
title: Maritime Trade in Turmoil
description:
The ongoing war severely disrupts maritime shipping routes, causing significant logistical challenges. This disruption impacts critical supply chains, escalating economic volatility and straining international trade relations. 

The ripple effects of these disruptions are felt across various sectors, from consumer goods to energy supplies, underscoring the vital role of stable maritime corridors in global commerce.

name: Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomAverageOutput
title: Average Gas Imports from Gasom
description: The average level of natural gas exports from Sordland's Gasom corporation to Rizia indicates a stable yet cautious energy relationship. While a consistent supply is assured, it may also cause a dependency that could be risky in fluctuating market conditions.

name: Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomHighOutput
title: Increased Gas Imports from Gasom
description: The significant increase in natural gas imports from Gasom bolsters our nation's energy supply, enhancing its industrial and domestic energy stability. This surge represents a strong diplomatic bond with Sordland, but also underlines the importance of maintaining diversified energy sources to prevent over-reliance on a single provider.

name: Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomLowOutput
title: Reduced Gas Imports from Gasom
description: The decrease in natural gas exports from Gasom has worsened energy insecurity, driving up prices, and impacting both Rizia's economy and our citizens' daily lives. There is an urgent need to diversify energy sources and enhance domestic production.

name: Diplomacy_Sordland_HighValueBonds
title: High-Value Sordish Government Bonds
description:
The high valuation of Sordish government bonds signifies a robust economic upturn in Sordland, leading to lucrative investment opportunities. These bonds offer substantial returns amid a stable economic climate. 

The advantageous bond market reflects a well-calibrated investment strategy, capitalizing on favorable economic conditions and strengthening our nation's financial portfolio.

name: Diplomacy_Sordland_LowValueBonds
title: Low-Value Sordish Government Bonds
description: The low valuation of Sordish government bonds indicates economic instability in Sordland, adversely impacting investment prospects. This decline in bond value exemplifies the inherent risks of international financial markets and the need for diversified investment portfolios.

name: Diplomacy_Sordland_MediumValueBonds
title: Medium-Value Sordish Government Bonds
description: The medium valuation of Sordish government bonds reflects an uncertain economic environment in Sordland, with fluctuating returns impacting our nation's investment strategies. These bonds, while offering moderate gains, also bring to light the risks inherent in foreign government securities.

name: Diplomacy_Sordland_WhiskeyImports
title: Sordish Whiskey Imports
description: The nation's import of Sordish whiskey has significantly increased. This import growth not only enriches the domestic beverage sector with diverse choices, but also strengthens our economic and cultural relations with Sordland.

name: Diplomacy_Sordland_WineExports
title: Rizian Wine Exports to Sordland
description: The export of Rizian wines to Sordland has witnessed remarkable growth, showcasing the quality and appeal of national viticulture on the international stage. This increase in exports not only boosts the local wine industry but also solidifies our economic and cultural ties with Sordland.

name: Diplomacy_StrategicAllianceMember
title: Strategic Alliance Member
description: Sordland is a strategic member of a large and important international alliance, which has increased its prestige and influence on the global stage. The membership in this alliance displays Sordland's participation in promoting cooperation and its desire to contribute to global affairs.

name: Diplomacy_TerritorialIntegrity_Lost
title: Lost Territorial Integrity
description: The country faces a significant setback with the loss of its ancestral lands of Pales and the vital territory of Zille. This territorial loss has not only impacted the national pride and history but has also posed challenges in terms of strategic positioning and resource allocation.

name: Diplomacy_TerritorialIntegrity_PartiallyRestored
title: Partially Restored Territorial Integrity
description:
The nation has achieved notable success in regaining control over parts of its ancestral lands. This partial restoration of territorial integrity has uplifted national sentiment and provided strategic advantages. 

However, the complete recovery and integration of these territories remains a work in progress, necessitating continued diplomatic and strategic efforts.

name: Diplomacy_TerritorialIntegrity_Reclaimed
title: Reclaimed Territorial Integrity
description: The successful reclamation of both of Rizia's historically significant territories, Pales and Zille, marks a major milestone. This achievement not only restores national pride and unity, but also bolsters our international standing and access to resources.

name: Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Derdia_EnergyFailed
title: Derdia Energy Deal Cancelled
description: Since we could not honor our side of the energy deal, Derdia has decided to cancel the contract between our countries.

name: Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Morella_EnergyFailed
title: Morella Energy Deal Cancelled
description: Since we could not honor our side of the energy deal, Morella has decided to cancel the contract between our countries.

name: Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg_EnergyFailed
title: Rumburg Energy Deal Cancelled
description: Since we could not honor our side of the energy deal, Rumburg has decided to cancel the contract between our countries.

name: Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Wehlen_EnergyFailed
title: Wehlen Energy Deal Cancelled
description: Since we could not honor our side of the energy deal, Wehlen has decided to cancel the contract between our countries.

name: Diplomacy_TradeVolume_Average
title: Average Trade Volume
description: The nation maintains a steady trade volume, ensuring consistent economic growth. Trade partnerships and policies are continually reviewed to optimize trade relations and secure the best possible economic outcomes for the nation.

name: Diplomacy_TradeVolume_Increased
title: Increased Trade Volume
description:
The nation has experienced a significant increase in trade volume, indicating a period of strong economic growth and effective trade policy implementation. This expansion reflects improved trade relations and strategic diversification of the export-import portfolio. 

The increased trade volume not only bolsters the national economy but also demonstrates the Kingdom's adaptability and competitiveness in the international market.

name: Diplomacy_TradeVolume_Low
title: Low Trade Volume
description:
The nation faces a concerning decrease in trade volume, indicating a downturn in economic performance and challenges in international trade relations.

The decline in trade impacts not just the economy but also the nation's ability to exert influence and secure favorable terms in the global marketplace, necessitating a critical review and adjustment of trade policies and partnerships.

name: Diplomacy_UCAid
title: United Contanan Aid
description: United Contana has announced a substantial amount of financial, logistical, and equipment aid to support Sordland. The aid package is a testament to the strong diplomatic ties between the two nations and United Contana's commitment to providing support and prosperity.

name: Diplomacy_UnitedContanaTradeHalt
title: Embargoed by United Contana
description: United Contana has imposed an embargo on all goods from Sordland, creating a significant challenge for Sordland's economy. The embargo underscores the importance of careful management of international trade and the need for Sordland to diversify its trading partnerships.

name: Diplomacy_Valgsland_Coal_Trade
title: Coal Trade with Valgsland
description: The comprehensive agreement between Sordland and Valgsland to reduce regulations and barriers has enabled Valgsland to become Sordland's leading export trading partner of coal from Lorren.

name: Diplomacy_Valgsland_Fish_Trade
title: Fish Trade with Valgsland
description: Sordland and Valgsland have signed a comprehensive agreement to reduce regulations and barriers, which has made Valgsland Sordland's leading export trading partner of fish from Agnland. The agreement represents a significant milestone in the relationship between the two nations.

name: Diplomacy_ValgslandTradeTariffs
title: Trade Tariffs by Valgsland
description: Valgsland has imposed damaging tariffs on Sordland's most important traded goods, creating significant economic harm. The imposition of tariffs has had a negative impact on Sordland's economy and the trade relationship between the two nations.

name: Diplomacy_Valgsland_Tungsten_Trade
title: Tungsten Trade with Valgsland
description: Sordland and Valgsland have reached a comprehensive agreement to reduce regulations and barriers, resulting in Valgsland becoming Sordland's leading export trading partner of Tungsten.

name: Diplomacy_Valgsland_Wheat_Trade
title: Wheat Trade with Valgsland
description: Sordland and Valgsland have signed a comprehensive agreement to reduce regulations and barriers, which has made Valgsland Sordland's leading export trading partner of wheat from Bergia.

name: Diplomacy_Wehlen_AntiBFFAid
title: Wehlen Anti-BFF Aid
description: Support is being actively provided to Wehlen in its struggle against the Bludish Freedom Front, amidst escalating tensions in the Bludish regions driven by the BFF’s history of insurgency and armed conflict. Military and logistical assistance is aimed at strengthening Wehlen’s stabilization efforts, reflecting a significant diplomatic and military engagement.

name: Diplomacy_Wehlen_ArmsExport
title: Arms Export to Wehlen
description: The export of small arms to Wehlen is carried out under strict regulatory oversight to ensure compliance with international trade laws. This carefully managed trade supports Wehlen's defense needs while maintaining strategic balance, reflecting a dedication to responsible arms trading.

name: Diplomacy_Wehlen_FreeTariffs_Oil
title: Tariff Free Oil Trade with Wehlen
description: According to the agreement, all oil imports from Wehlen are now tariff-free. This development is expected to have a positive impact on Sordland's economy by reducing the cost of energy imports and stimulating growth with affordable energy.

name: Diplomacy_Wehlen_GasExport
title: Gas Exports to Wehlen
description: The significant increase in gas exports to Wehlen marks a strategic success in the nation's energy sector, enhancing its role as a key regional supplier. This surge in exports not only strengthens economic ties with Wehlen but also highlights the nation's capability to meet regional energy demands.

name: Diplomacy_Wehlen_GoldExport
title: Gold Exports to Wehlen
description: Gold exports from Rizia to Wehlen have achieved a new record level, contributing significantly to Rizia's export revenues. This trade has strengthened the position of the kingdom as a prominent gold producer.

name: Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport
title: Oil Imports from Wehlen
description: The nation has seen a notable rise in oil imports from Wehlen, indicating a strategic move to diversify and secure its energy supplies. This increase not only enhances energy security, but also solidifies trade relations with Wehlen.

name: Diplomacy_Wehlen_Pharmaceuticals
title: Pharmaceuticals from Wehlen
description:
The import of morphine, opioids, and other pharmaceuticals from Wehlen maintains a consistent level, ensuring a reliable supply for Rizia's healthcare sector. These imports are critical for various medical treatments and pain management. 

Regulatory compliance and quality control measures are strictly adhered to, ensuring the safety and efficacy of these pharmaceutical products.

name: Diplomacy_Wehlen_TobaccoImport
title: Tobacco Imports from Wehlen
description: Tobacco imports from Wehlen are at a heightened level, catering to demand without exacerbating health concerns. This equilibrium supports both Wehlen’s export economy and Rizia's public health policies.

name: Diplomacy_Wehlen_WineExport
title: Wine Exports to Wehlen
description:
Wine exports to Wehlen demonstrate consistent growth, highlighting the region's renowned winemaking tradition. The trade is marked by a variety of high-quality Rizian wines, appealing to a broad consumer base in Wehlen. 

These exports represent a key sector in Rizia's trade portfolio.

name: Diplomacy_Wehlen_WoodImport
title: Wood and Furniture from Wehlen
description:
The import of timber, furniture, and woodcarvings from Wehlen is experiencing a notable growth, positively impacting Rizia's construction and interior design sectors. 

The trade is characterized by a diverse range of high-quality wood products, reflecting Wehlen's strong forestry and craftsmanship industries.

name: Diplomacy_Zille_ATAFunded
title: ATA Operations Active in Zille
description: The Ariana Toras Association is active in the territory of Zille and is enhancing our soft power projection and influence among the people. This improves the image of our culture among the locals.

name: Diplomacy_Zille_GrowingArmedResistance
title: Growing Pro-Rizia Armed Resistance
description:
Amidst increasing public dissent, a growing armed resistance movement has emerged within the Zille region, advocating for its return to Rizia. This movement, fueled by discontent over Wehlen's governance and a strong desire for reunification with Rizia, has begun organizing and staging minor yet notable operations. 

Their actions signify a significant escalation in the push for Zille’s reintegration, highlighting unresolved tensions stemming from the Zille Agreement.

name: Diplomacy_Zille_GrowingRiziaMovement
title: Growing Pro-Rizia Movement
description:
The movement supporting Zille's reintegration with Rizia is gaining ground, marked by increasing public support and organized advocacy. This growing movement, fueled by a sense of national identity and dissatisfaction with Wehlen’s governance, is steadily gathering strength. 

Their expanding influence reflects a rising tide of sentiment against the prolonged separation of Zille from Rizia.

name: Diplomacy_Zille_MassiveRiziaMovement
title: Massive Pro-Rizia Movement
description:
A massive, widespread movement advocating for Zille's return to Rizia has gained extraordinary momentum. With substantial public backing and growing political advocacy, this movement has become a significant force, peacefully yet assertively demanding the region’s reunification with Rizia. 

Their considerable influence signifies a strong, unified call against the continued effects of the Zille Agreement.

name: Diplomacy_Zille_SmallRiziaMovement
title: Small Pro-Rizia Movement
description:
The movement pushing for Zille's reintegration into Rizia remains minimal and fragmented. With limited public support and scarce resources, their efforts to challenge Wehlen's governance have been largely ineffectual. 

This lack of momentum highlights the difficulties in rallying widespread support for the cause, despite underlying discontent with the Zille Agreement.

name: Diplomacy_Zille_StrongArmedResistance
title: Strong Pro-Rizia Armed Resistance
description: The Pro-Rizia resistance in the Zille region has grown stronger, gaining organizational capacity and local support, fueled by discontent with Wehlen’s rule. The movement asserts a significant, though non-violent, presence advocating for reunification.

name: Diplomacy_Zille_WeakArmedResistance
title: Weak Pro-Rizia Armed Resistance
description:
The armed resistance movement advocating for Zille's return to Rizia has seen a notable decline in strength and support. Hindered by internal divisions and a lack of resources, their impact has diminished, leaving the movement struggling to maintain relevance. 

This weakening resistance reflects the complexities and challenges faced by those opposing Wehlen's control over Zille.

name: Economy_AdvancedShipbuilding
title: Advanced Ship Building
description: Investments into the local shipbuilding sector are paying off. New shipyards and production lines are operational, pushing forward technological innovation in naval engineering. This expansion creates steady jobs and fuels economic growth in coastal regions, strengthening both the kingdom’s commercial and military fleets.

name: Economy_Agnland_EconomicStabilisation
title: Agnland: Economy Stabilizes
description: Thanks to the investments made by Sordland, the Agnland Region is stabilizing its economy. However, the region is still facing economic challenges and struggles to achieve sustainable growth.

name: Economy_Agnland_LackInvestment
title: Agnland: Lacks Investment
description: The Agnland region is in crisis as the lack of investment has led to a rapid decline in its economy. The region, which was once known for its stable economy, is now facing unprecedented challenges that threaten its social fabric and economic stability. With rising levels of crime, homelessness, and unemployment, the region is struggling to cope.

name: Economy_Agnland_MajorFishExport
title: Agnland: Fish Export and Tourism Hub
description: The Agnland region is becoming known for its rapid production and export of fish, which has helped to boost its economy. Additionally, Sordland's famous cold-water Salmon has become a popular attraction for tourists, driving further growth in the region's economy.

name: Economy_ArmsExporter
title: Arms Exporter
description: Arms exports have now exceeded millions of tonnes, cementing us as a major player in the market and placing the nation among the top 10 arms exporters worldwide. This development brings substantial economic benefits but also provokes ethical concerns and diplomatic scrutiny.

name: Economy_ArmsImporter
title: Arms Importer
description: Arms imports have increased significantly, marked by the procurement of advanced weaponry. While this enhances defensive strength, it also raises concerns about regional power dynamics and the potential for escalating military tensions.

name: Economy_Aureus_HighExtraction
title: High Extraction from Aureus Field
description: The kingdom achieves complete extraction rights to the Aureus Gas Field, securing 100% ownership. This development significantly boosts the kingdom's energy independence and economic growth, but also places immense responsibility on managing environmental and resource sustainability.

name: Economy_Aureus_LowExtraction
title: Low Extraction from Aureus Field
description: With only 25% extraction rights in the Aureus Gas Field, Rizia's control over this crucial energy asset is significantly limited. This situation provides modest benefits to the energy sector and economy, but falls short of the potential impact of greater ownership.

name: Economy_Aureus_LowExtractionPostWar
title: Low Extraction from Aureus Field
description: Though Rizia now holds full extraction rights to the vital Aureus Gas Field following the recent conflict, the infrastructure lies in disrepair. War damage has reduced operational capacity to just 25%, curbing the immediate benefits of this strategic gain and delaying its full economic potential.

name: Economy_Aureus_MediumExtraction
title: Medium Extraction from Aureus Field
description: Rizia holds 50% extraction rights in the Aureus Gas Field, sharing ownership with external entities. This arrangement contributes to the energy sector and economy, but limits the kingdom's full potential gains and control over the gas reserves.

name: Economy_Aureus_MediumExtractionPostWar
title: Medium Extraction from Aureus Field
description: Though Rizia now holds full extraction rights to the vital Aureus Gas Field following the recent conflict, the infrastructure lies in disrepair. War damage has reduced operational capacity to just 50%, curbing the immediate benefits of this strategic gain and delaying its full economic potential.

name: Economy_AverageTransportation
title: Average Transportation Links
description: The government's recent investment in infrastructure has had a positive impact on the transportation network connections, which have slightly recovered. However, there is still a need for additional investment to fully restore the transportation network and support sustainable economic growth.

name: Economy_BalancingMixed
title: Balancing Economic Sectors
description: The nation experiences a shift in its energy sector, balancing traditional industries with other alternatives. This mixed approach reflects a cautious yet progressive step towards diversification, balancing stability with the need for innovation.

name: Economy_Bergia_EconomicDownturn
title: Bergia: Economy Plummets
description: The region's economy is declining at a rapid rate due to the lack of investment, resulting in an increase in crime, homelessness, and unemployment. We must take immediate action to address the underlying issues by increasing investment, promoting job growth, and creating new economic opportunities.

name: Economy_Bergia_EconomicStabilisation
title: Bergia: Economy Stabilizes
description: The investments made by Sordland have helped to stabilize the economy of the Bergia Region. However, the region is still facing social challenges, including some racial tensions between the Bludish People and the local Sords.

name: Economy_Bergia_MajorAgriculturalZone
title: Bergia: Major Agricultural Zone
description: The investments made by Sordland are accelerating the economy of the Bergia Region, positioning it to become a major agricultural zone. Bergia's growing economy represents a significant opportunity for Sordland to expand its agricultural sector and increase its economic competitiveness.

name: Economy_BusinessBailout
title: Businesses Bailed Out
description: The government's support for businesses under financial strain has slightly stabilized the downward spiral of unemployment. While the economic situation remains challenging, the support provided by the government has helped to mitigate the negative impact on employment.

name: Economy_CapitalWithdrawals
title: Capital Withdrawals
description: Sordland is experiencing a large outflow of private capital, causing significant disruptions to recent investments, job security, and overall economic stability. The outflow of capital may result in continued economic challenges, including job losses and reduced investment.

name: Economy_Consistent
title: Consistent Economy
description: Our economic strategy is closely aligned with the type of development doctrine that we are promoting, which emphasizes the importance of promoting sustainable economic growth, enhancing global competitiveness, and creating new opportunities for investment and job creation.

name: Economy_ConsumerManufacturing_Boom
title: Consumer Manufacturing Boom
description: The consumer manufacturing sector is thriving, bringing an influx of jobs and boosting the economy through increased domestic production. The growth has improved access to locally made goods and contributed to overall economic resilience.

name: Economy_CorporateExploitation
title: Corporate Exploitation
description:
The dominance of corporations in the economy has led to significant power imbalances, allowing them to shape market conditions to their advantage. 

This concentration of influence has exacerbated inequality, reduced opportunities for fair competition, and fueled widespread discontent among the populace, resulting in increasing tensions.

name: Economy_DebtCrisis
title: Debt Crisis
description: Sordland is facing a debt crisis due to the government's reckless spending and widening budget deficit. The situation has resulted in a significant increase in government debt, raising concerns about the country's ability to pay its debts without the assistance of a third party. The situation highlights the need for policies that promote fiscal responsibility, including reducing government spending.

name: Economy_DecreasedTrade
title: Decreased Trade Volume
description: Previous government attempts to solidify trade relations were unsuccessful, which combined with the effects of the recession, resulted in a significant decrease in trade volume. Without effective measures to address the underlying issues driving the decrease, the country may face continued economic challenges.

name: Economy_DiminishingOilIndustry
title: Diminishing Oil Industry
description: The kingdom's once-thriving oilfields are running dry. With wells producing less each year, the energy demands of the local industries and binding export agreements with our neighbors are pushing the sector to its limits.

name: Economy_Diversification
title: Diversification of the Economy
description: The economy undergoes significant diversification, integrating different sectors into the traditional mix. This transition marks a forward-thinking move, positioning the nation as a leader in innovation and economic resilience.

name: Economy_EmergencyFunds
title: Emergency Funds Withdrawn
description: The emergency funds have given us a huge relief on our debt situation. Regrettably, it has been shunned by the majority of our citizens as they blaming the administration for incompetency in budget spending. Some are raising conspiracy theories of government officials' embezzlement and corruption.

name: Economy_EnergyCrisis
title: Energy Crisis
description:
The nation is currently grappling with a severe energy crisis. This severe situation has led to widespread power outages, disruptions in industrial production, and escalating public discontent. 

The crisis stems from a confluence of factors, including depleted reserves, infrastructural challenges, and international trade complications. 

This energy shortage poses a critical challenge to Rizia's economic stability and quality of life, necessitating urgent and effective solutions.

name: Economy_EsqirisGasField_AverageExtractionVolume
title: Esqiris Gas Field: Average Extraction Volume
description: The Esqiris gas fields hum with steady activity, ensuring Rizia's industries don't falter. This consistent output, in a volatile energy landscape, is the pride of Rizian Oil and Gas and has been commended by international trade partners.

name: Economy_EsqirisGasField_HighExtractionVolume
title: Esqiris Gas Field: High Extraction Volume
description: The Esqiris gas fields operate at high extraction volumes, significantly bolstering the nation's industrial and energy sectors. This high output not only reinforces economic stability but also enhances Rizia's standing in international energy markets.

name: Economy_ExpensiveWorkersPayments
title: Increased Employee Costs
description: The expansion of labor rights in Sordland has created new costs for businesses, resulting in increased expenditures related to employment. While this is a positive development for promoting fair and equitable working conditions, it may also create challenges for businesses in terms of their expenditures.

name: Economy_FinancialInvestment_Arcasia
title: Investments from Arcasia
description: Many Arcasian companies are opening new branches, expanding their existing operations and forming Sordish based subsidiaries, bolstering our economy and creating opportunities for jobs and further investments.

name: Economy_FinancialInvestment_UC
title: Investments from United Contana
description: Many Contanan state companies are opening new branches, expanding their existing operations and forming Sordish based subsidiaries, bolstering our economy and creating opportunities for jobs and further investments.

name: Economy_FootballTeams_Continental
title: Continental Quality Football Teams
description: Rizia's football clubs are charging ahead, garnering continental acclaim. Rizian teams are consistently holding their own against the region's best, filling stadiums and asserting their dominance on the field. The nation's youth dream of donning the colors of Real Montaklar or FC Porte Drazon.

name: Economy_FootballTeams_Regional
title: Regional Quality Football Teams
description: The nation's football clubs show reduced quality, competing admirably only on a regional level. Fans lament their teams' declined prowess, and national pride has suffered as Rizian football loses its worldwide renown.

name: Economy_GlobalEnergyPrice_Average
title: Global Energy Prices: Average
description: Global energy prices have stabilized at a moderate level. While Rizia still benefits from its energy exports, the revenue is consistent with historical averages, providing a predictable yet less invigorated boost to the national economy. The stability, however, ensures a level of economic predictability and planning for both the state and private enterprises.

name: Economy_GlobalEnergyPrice_High
title: Global Energy Prices: High
description: Elevated global energy prices currently favor Rizia, boosting the nation's export revenues. This favorable market condition is enhancing the state's economic position and allowing for greater fiscal flexibility. Domestic energy corporations are reaping the benefits, leading to potential increases in local investments and job opportunities.

name: Economy_GlobalEnergyPrice_Low
title: Global Energy Prices: Low
description: The global energy market is experiencing a downturn, with prices dropping significantly. As a prominent energy exporter, Rizia faces reduced export earnings, which may strain the national budget and economic stability. This downturn puts added pressure on diversifying the economy and exploring alternative revenue streams.

name: Economy_GlobalTradeWar
title: Global Trade War
description: A confrontation between superpowers has resulted in an economic war, with sanctions and embargoes disrupting global trade. Without effective measures to address the underlying issues driving the economic war, the situation may result in reduced investor confidence, job losses, and reduced economic growth in affected countries.

name: Economy_Gruni_LaggingBehind
title: Gruni: Lagging Behind in Development
description: Gruni, despite its fertile lands and vibrant economy, is encountering a downturn due to a deficit of sustained investment. The consequences are visible in the escalating rates of crime, unemployment, and homelessness. These challenges are severely affecting the residents of the region, posing a significant hurdle to their quality of life and access to essential services.

name: Economy_Gruni_LightTowerRegion
title: Gruni: Beacon of Success
description: Boosted by well-placed investments, Gruni is witnessing a surge in economic progress. The region, celebrated for its vineyards, tourism, and critical ports, is evolving into a key center for trade and commerce in Sordland. Businesses and investors are increasingly recognizing Gruni's growth potential and economic vitality.

name: Economy_Gruni_MaintainingGrowth
title: Gruni: Barely Maintains Growth
description: Despite concerted efforts and strategic investments, the economic situation in Gruni is demonstrating marginal stability. The region, famed for its fertile vineyards and vital export sector, is grappling with notable economic challenges that impact its growth potential.

name: Economy_HighEmployment
title: High Employment
description: Recent successful investments in Sordland have resulted in the creation of thousands of jobs, leading to a significant reduction in unemployment rates. The situation highlights the importance of effective policies that promote investment and job creation, including measures to support businesses and entrepreneurs.

name: Economy_ImprovedTransportation
title: Improved Transportation Links
description: The extensive infrastructure investments made by the government have resulted in a complete overhaul of the transportation network in Sordland. Critical infrastructure investments included measures to support the development of modern and efficient transportation systems.

name: Economy_IncreasedTrade
title: Increased Trade Volume
description: New successful trade agreements have led to an increase in the volume of traded goods between Sordland and the wider region. Increased trade has significant positive impacts on economic growth and development, promoting increased investment, job creation, and increased access to goods and services.

name: Economy_LargeBusiness_CreateJobs
title: Large Corporations Creating Jobs
description: Thanks to our tax break initiative, major corporations are opening more positions and providing jobs for Sordland's population. Increased employment opportunities have had significant positive impacts on economic growth and development, promoting increased investment, job creation, and increased access to goods and services.

name: Economy_LargeBusiness_Downsize
title: Large Corporations Downsize
description: Due to our tax increase, major corporations in Sordland are downsizing and reducing their workforce, resulting in a significant number of job losses and leaving many citizens unemployed. Job losses have negative impacts on economic growth and development, reducing investment, limiting access to goods and services, and harming local communities.

name: Economy_LesPower_CheapPrices
title: Cheaper Price Gas Imports from LesPower
description: A trade agreement with Lespian company LesPower has resulted in cheaper gas imports. This change positively impacts the national budget and energy consumption but requires strategic management to maximize benefits.

name: Economy_LesPower_HighPrices
title: Highly Priced Gas Imports from LesPower
description: A recent trade deal with Lespian energy company LesPower has led to higher-priced gas imports. The agreed increase strains the economy and daily life, necessitating adjustments in energy strategies and consumption.

name: Economy_LocalCoalExtraction_Average
title: Average Local Coal Extraction
description: Coal mines across Rizia maintain a steady pace, meeting the nation's industrial demands. Amid global shifts to natural gas and other sources, Rizia's reliance on coal remains anchored in its industrial heartland. Environmentalists raise concerns, urging a shift to sustainable alternatives.

name: Economy_LocalCoalExtraction_High
title: High Local Coal Extraction
description: The coal mines operate at high efficiency, meeting and exceeding the nation's industrial needs. While this boosts the industrial sector, it also draws environmental concerns, highlighting the need for balancing economic gains with ecological responsibility.

name: Economy_LocalGoldExtraction_Average
title: Average Local Gold Extraction
description: Gold veins continue to yield steady outputs, bolstering the economic backbone and securing a prominent role in global markets, with financial analysts closely observing trends for future developments.

name: Economy_LocalGoldExtraction_High
title: High Local Gold Extraction
description: The gold mining sector witnesses a surge in output, strengthening the nation's economic foundations. This increase in gold production enhances Rizia's influence in global markets and bolsters financial stability.

name: Economy_Lorren_EconomicStabilisation
title: Lorren: Economy Stabilizing
description: The Lorren Region is beginning to stabilize its economy thanks to the investments we have made in the area. However, despite these efforts, the region is still facing significant economic challenges that are affecting its ability to thrive.

name: Economy_Lorren_ProductionAndTradeCenter
title: Lorren: Major Trade Hub for Production and Energy
description: The Lorren Region is experiencing accelerated economic growth thanks to the investments we have made in the area. The region has become a major hub for trade, production and energy in Sordland, with businesses and investors taking notice of its potential for growth and development.

name: Economy_Lorren_RustBelt
title: Lorren: Rust Belt
description: The economy of the region is experiencing a rapid decline due to a lack of investment. This has resulted in a rise in crime, homelessness, and unemployment. These challenges have a significant impact on the region's residents, with many struggling to make ends meet and access basic services.

name: Economy_LuxuryPriceIncreased
title: Increased Luxury Good Prices
description: The recently passed luxury goods tax has been implemented to target the wealthy population and their extravagant spending habits. This has resulted in a significant increase in the prices of luxury items such as jewelry, furs, sports cars, yachts, and private planes across Sordland.

name: Economy_MarketsCrash
title: Black Tuesday Crash
description: The financial system in Sordland has experienced a massive collapse as a result of a currency crash and the ensuing economic fallout. This has had severe consequences for the country's economy and its citizens, with many facing unemployment, poverty, and other hardships.

name: Economy_MFILoans
title: International MFI Loans
description: Sordland has recently obtained significant funds from the global institution, MFI, which has helped to reduce the country's central bank debt. While this has provided some relief, many citizens are concerned about the implications of accepting external funding and the potential impact on the country's global influence.

name: Economy_MITZ_HighResourceOutput
title: MITZ: High Resource Output
description: The Meftiem International Trade Zone boasts a resource boom that's driving economic prosperity. As member nations benefit, Rizia stands at the forefront, navigating this golden period. Economists predict a robust trajectory for the foreseeable future.

name: Economy_MITZ_LowResourceOutput
title: MITZ: Low Resource Output
description: The Meftiem International Trade Zone faces challenges with low resource output, impacting economic momentum. This slowdown requires strategic adjustments to rejuvenate trade and secure our position in the global economic landscape.

name: Economy_MITZ_MediumResourceOutput
title: MITZ: Medium Resource Output
description: The Meftiem International Trade Zone experiences moderate resource output, contributing to steady economic growth. This balanced performance underlines our significant role in regional trade, maintaining a solid position in the international market.

name: Economy_MITZ_StricterRegulations
title: Stricter Regulations in MITZ
description: The Meftiem International Trade Zone faces challenges as new regulations are implemented for its workers. While celebrated by labor advocacy groups, the extra bureacracy involved has resulted in less efficient operations, leading to a reduction in output.

name: Economy_MonetaryInaction
title: Monetary Inaction
description: Without the stimulus fund needed, many households and businesses are filing for bankruptcy. Leading to goods and services being reduced and unemployment rates risen. As such, investments and savings across the country are declining at an alarming rate.

name: Economy_NelvisarOilField_Depleted
title: Nelvisar Oil Field: Depleted
description: The Nelvisar oil fields are experiencing severe underproduction, signaling a depletion phase. This downturn in oil output raises significant concerns for the energy sector and broader economy, with investor confidence and market stability at stake.

name: Economy_NelvisarOilField_LowExtractionVolume
title: Nelvisar Oil Field: Low Extraction Volume
description: Amid global energy demands, the Nelvisar fields are underproducing, ringing alarm bells in Rizia's energy sector. It's crucial to unearth the root causes and adapt swiftly to prevent economic ripples. Investors are watching closely, waiting for a positive turnaround.

name: Economy_NewBusiness_Collapse
title: Collapse in New Business
description: Rizia faces a sharp decline in new business registrations, indicating a worrying entrepreneurial slump. This trend threatens to stagnate the economy, necessitating immediate measures to revive the spirit of innovation and business growth.

name: Economy_NewBusiness_Reduction
title: Reduction in New Business
description: A concerning lull pervades Rizia's entrepreneurial landscape as new business registrations see a slump. With potential innovators hesitating, the economy risks stagnating, calling for urgent introspection. Analysts are diving deep to discern underlying causes and recommend strategies.

name: Economy_NewBusiness_Rise
title: Massive Rise in New Business
description: A surge in new business registrations marks a vibrant phase in the nation's entrepreneurial landscape. This uptick reflects a robust economic environment, fostering innovation and bolstering overall economic health.

name: Economy_NewBusiness_SlowGrowth
title: Slow Growth in New Business
description: The business environment shows a stable increase in new business registrations, indicating a slightly positive entrepreneurial situation. This trend could improve the economy in the long run, for now it keeps the spirit of innovation and business growth going.

name: Economy_PandemicFallout
title: Pandemic Fallout
description: The polio disease is spreading rapidly in the regions surrounding Bergia, and local officials have taken action to prevent its further spread. In affected areas, mayors have imposed lockdown measures to reduce transmission, which may have short-term economic impacts.

name: Economy_PDStockExchange_Balanced
title: Balanced Stock Market Influence
description: The stock exchange reflects growing but cautious international engagements. While some diplomatic relationships have strengthened investor interest, the market remains susceptible to shifts in international stability, leading to a moderate, unpredictable performance.

name: Economy_PDStockExchange_Thriving
title: Thriving Stock Market with Global Influence
description: Strong diplomatic ties and stable international relations have boosted the stock exchange, making it a hub for regional and foreign investment. This has led to economic development rewards, attracting an influx of new businesses and fueling broad-based growth across the nation.

name: Economy_PDStockExchange_Weak
title: Fragile Stock Market Vulnerability
description: The stock exchange is struggling due to unstable diplomatic ties and fluctuating international relations. Uncertainty around the nation's global standing has led to decreased investor confidence, making the market highly volatile and susceptible to external disruptions.

name: Economy_PharmaIndustry_Advanced
title: Medicine Prices Lowered
description: The growth of the local pharmaceutical industry has led to cheaper production costs, allowing the state to purchase medicines at lower prices. Hospitals and clinics are now better stocked with essential drugs, improving public healthcare.

name: Economy_PharmaIndustry_Growing
title: Pharma Industry Growing
description: State-backed initiatives have spurred growth in the local pharmaceutical sector, fostering new production facilities and research hubs. While progress is steady, the industry still relies on imports to meet national healthcare demands.

name: Economy_PharmaIndustry_Reliant
title: Reliance on Foreign Pharmaceuticals
description: The domestic pharmaceutical industry remains reliant on imported raw materials and expertise. This dependence leaves the nation vulnerable to global market fluctuations, causing price hikes and shortages.

name: Economy_PrintMoney
title: Central Bank Prints Money
description: The central bank's decision to print millions of Sordish ren has provided a significant boost to the government budget in the short term. However, this move has been met with disapproval from a majority of citizens, including both radical and economic experts. Concerns have been raised about the potential abuse of power and the long-term impact of inflation on the economy.

name: Economy_PrivateSector_Expanded
title: Private Sector Expanded
description: In an effort to boost the private sector and encourage competition, the government has sold its shares in state-owned companies. This move has allowed for more private investment and greater efficiency in the market. However, it has also led to concerns about the loss of government control and potential exploitation by private companies.

name: Economy_PrivatizationLow
title: Economic Control by Monarchy and Nobility
description: The economy is predominantly controlled by the monarchy and three influential noble families, maintaining a feudal-like economic structure. The lack of opportunity for common citizens and small businesses has led to rising inequality and entrenched power.

name: Economy_PrivatizationWave
title: Rise of Private Enterprise
description: As privatization reforms are introduced, corporations and private entities gain influence in certain economic sectors. The balance between noble-owned resources and emerging corporate competition leads to improved market dynamics, innovation and economic growth, though it also raises fears of eroding traditional power structures.

name: Economy_ProductionCapacity_Average
title: Average Industrial Production Capacity
description: Manufacturing sector is chugging along at a moderate pace, with some production facilities operating below maximum capacity. This middling performance is noticeable in the market, with some concerns about meeting both domestic and international demands. The consequences, though not dire, impact various facets, from job stability to fulfilling export orders.

name: Economy_ProductionCapacity_High
title: High Industrial Production Capacity
description: The manufacturing sector is thriving, with production facilities operating at maximum capacity to meet both domestic and international demand. This surge has created widespread positive effects, including job stability and increased exports. However, the heightened activity has also led to a significant rise in energy consumption, underscoring the need for careful resource management.

name: Economy_ProductionCapacity_Low
title: Low Production Capacity
description: Rizia's manufacturing heartbeat slows, with production facilities not operating at full throttle. This deceleration, palpable in the market, raises concerns about meeting domestic and international demands. The ripple effects are being felt, from job security to export commitments.

name: Economy_ProductionIncreased
title: Production Increased
description: Thanks to a new investment focused on production, Sordland has experienced a significant boost in economic growth. This investment has had a ripple effect throughout the country, resulting in increased output of various industries and sectors. This move has allowed for increased competition and innovation.

name: Economy_ProductionStagnation
title: Stagnated Production
description: The mismanagement and lack of direction of economic policies, along with the recession, has resulted in a stagnation in production of goods. As a consequence, the country's economy is struggling to recover, with high unemployment rates and decreasing business investments.

name: Economy_ProvincialTaxes_Avoided
title: Avoidance in Provincial Tax Payments
description: Significant tax evasion in Brenas, Valenqiris, and Cardesse-Montaklar poses a major challenge to Rizia's fiscal health. This widespread avoidance impacts the nation's budget, highlighting a critical need for cross-provincial communication.

name: Economy_ProvincialTaxes_FullyPaid
title: Fully Paid Provincial Taxes
description: Brenas, Valenqiris, and Cardesse-Montaklar exhibit exemplary fiscal discipline, with complete tax compliance. This responsible financial conduct significantly bolsters the national treasury, reflecting the regions' commitment to Rizia's economic stability.

name: Economy_ProvincialTaxes_MostlyPaid
title: Most Provincial Taxes Paid
description: Brenas, Valenqiris, and Cardesse-Montaklar, key regional economies, contribute notably to fiscal responsibilities through their tax payments. However, the Treasury reports irregularities in these contributions, including delays and discrepancies, which pose challenges to the nation's financial planning and budgetary stability.

name: Economy_RecoveredTrade
title: Recovered Trade Volume
description: Recent diplomatic efforts by Sordland have led to the successful signing of a comprehensive trade deal with a significant trade partner, which has resulted in a noticeable recovery of trade volume. This has had a positive impact on the economy, as the increased trade has led to the creation of new jobs and an overall boost in economic activity.

name: Economy_RenewablesIndustry
title: Renewable Energy Industry
description: Rizia’s investment in the renewable energy sector is driving steady progress. New facilities focused on wind and hydroelectric power are operational, creating jobs, fostering economic growth and reducing reliance on traditional energy sources.

name: Economy_Rigid
title: Rigid Energy Economy
description: Locked in tradition, the economic landscape resists diversification. While stability reigns, some are wary of overreliance on resources such as oil, gas and gold. The nation now faces a crossroads: to innovate or stick with what works.

name: Economy_RRG_StateOwns100
title: RRG: State Owns 100 Percent
description: The nationalization of Rizian Royal Gold places it entirely under state control. This complete ownership allows the government to directly steer the gold industry, aligning it closely with national economic strategies and interests.

name: Economy_RRG_StateOwns15
title: RRG: State Owns 15 Percent
description: The state's 15% ownership in Rizian Royal Gold, while minor, retains a strategic position. This stake allows the government to have a voice in the company's direction, ensuring that its operations align with broader national economic goals to some extent.

name: Economy_RRG_StateOwns30
title: RRG: State Owns 30 Percent
description: Holding a 30% stake in Rizian Royal Gold, the state maintains a notable influence in the company. This level of control ensures that national economic priorities are considered in RRG's functioning, amidst a predominantly private ownership structure.

name: Economy_RRG_StateOwns45
title: RRG: State Owns 45 Percent
description: With a 45% share, the state is a dominant minority stakeholder in Rizian Royal Gold. This significant ownership ensures that national interests are well-represented in the company's operations, balancing private enterprise with governmental influence.

name: Economy_SelfSufficiency_Dependant
title: Dependent Economy
description: The economy faces a concerning phase, as the nation heavily relies on imports for essential commodities. This dependency highlights the need for strategic shifts in trade and policy to build a more self-reliant future.

name: Economy_SelfSufficiency_Mostly
title: Mostly Self-Sufficient Economy
description: Having achieved high levels of self-sufficiency, the nation's economy now produces most of its essential needs. This independence reflects robust trade policies and a resilient economic structure, reducing reliance on foreign imports.

name: Economy_SelfSufficiency_Partial
title: Partially Self-sufficient Economy
description: Rizia's economic base displays partial self-sufficiency. While the nation produces a considerable portion of its needs, select commodities still demand import. The evolution of Rizia's trade policies points toward a more resilient economic future.

name: Economy_SmallBusiness_Growth
title: Small Business Growing
description: The recent tax break has led to a surge in small business growth, resulting in an increase in job opportunities throughout Sordland. This economic stimulus has provided a much-needed boost to the country's struggling job market and has helped to promote sustainable economic growth.

name: Economy_SmallBusiness_Stagnate
title: Small Business Stagnate
description: Sordland's tax increase has caused significant financial strain on small businesses, leading to stagnation or closure. As a result, many families are losing their homes and jobs, and the economy is suffering. Moreover, the increased cost of doing business has also led to a decline in the quality of goods and services provided.

name: Economy_Sordland_ResortInvestments
title: Sordland HOS Resort Deal
description: The agreement with Sordish businessman Marcel Koronti to develop a luxury resort in Valenqiris marks a notable joint venture between our two nations. While it promises tourism and economic benefits, the locals view the new development as an intrusion.

name: Economy_StateSector_Expanded
title: State Control Expanded
description: To expand the control of the state, the government has taken the decision to nationalize some private companies. By taking control of these companies, the government is able to allocate resources more efficiently and strategically, which will have an impact on the economy.

name: Economy_SteelIndustry
title: Advanced Steel Industry
description: The growing steel sector has led to the rise of advanced production facilities. The investments strengthen the industrial base, supports technological progress, and create new employment opportunities. The growth of steel manufacturing contributes directly to the kingdom’s broader economic stability and infrastructure development.

name: Economy_StimulusCheques
title: Stimulus Cheques Distributed
description: The government's provision of stimulus cheques to citizens in need has been a crucial lifeline for many struggling families, helping them pay for necessities such as food and rent. The relief effort has positively impacted millions of people across Sordland, providing them with the financial support they require to make ends meet.

name: Economy_SurvivingOilIndustry
title: Surviving Oil Industry
description: Recent investments have revitalized the struggling oil sector, boosting production enough to stabilize the market. While the kingdom still faces long-term challenges in meeting all domestic energy demands, these efforts provide crucial breathing room. For now, export commitments hold steady, and energy shortages are averted.

name: Economy_TaxAvoidance
title: Tax Avoidance
