description: There are currently peaceful protests taking place throughout the country in response to recent events. However, if the situation is not effectively managed, there is a risk that these peaceful demonstrations may escalate into more violent protests.

name: Order_Nationwide_Quelled
title: Nationwide Protests Quelled
description: Law and order have been restored throughout the country as the nationwide protests have been quelled thanks to the devoted efforts of the security forces. The government took swift action to address the protesters' concerns and engaged in constructive dialogue with the leaders of the movement, resulting in a peaceful resolution to the crisis.

name: Order_Nationwide_Revolt
title: Nationwide Revolt
description: The country is currently facing widespread violent protests as a result of recent events. The situation has become increasingly tense, and if not contained, it could cause significant harm to the country's economy and stability. Security forces are working tirelessly to restore order and prevent further violence.

name: Order_OrganisedCrime
title: Organised Crime
description: The Koranelli and Skinner cartel, among other dangerous criminal organizations, continue to conduct organized crime activities while remaining elusive to law enforcement. Their illegal operations have caused significant harm to society and the rule of law, and efforts to stop their activities have been largely unsuccessful. Despite the best efforts of the police and anti-crime units, these criminal networks continue to operate with impunity, creating a sense of fear and insecurity among citizens.

name: Order_OrganisedCrimeContained
title: Organised Crime Contained
description: Serious police work has led to a significant reduction in organized crime activities and has helped contain gangs within their home cities. The police have adopted a proactive approach to tackle organized crime, and they have been successful in arresting and prosecuting key members of criminal organizations. Furthermore, the police have collaborated with other law enforcement agencies and international partners to share information and coordinate operations to disrupt criminal activities.

name: Order_PoliceFactionalism
title: Police Factionalism
description: There has been some tension between traditional police units and the newly introduced community police, leading to factionalism within the law enforcement agencies. The introduction of community police was meant to improve policing in local communities and create a sense of ownership and responsibility among citizens. However, this new approach has caused friction with traditional police units who see it as a challenge to their authority and expertise.

name: Order_PoliceLeniency
title: Police Leniency
description: There have been reports of a decrease in crime rates across the country, but concerns have arisen regarding the leniency of local police in their respective neighborhoods. While this approach may help establish community trust and cooperation, it also has the potential to compromise the integrity of police work and lead to unchecked criminal activity.

name: Order_Prisons_Crowded
title: Prisons Overcrowded
description: The massive amount of arrests made during the instability and the violation of the suspension of protests has caused overcrowding in most prisons across the country. This situation has created significant problems, including sanitation issues, lack of access to healthcare, and increased tension among inmates.

name: Order_Prisons_Uncrowded
title: Emptied Prisons
description: There has been a significant decrease in crime rates in our country. This is largely due to a combination of factors, including welfare improvements that have helped to address the underlying issues that can lead to criminal behavior, as well as the implementation of capital punishment.

name: Order_ReductionOfCrimeCommunities
title: Lower Crime in Communities
description: The implementation of the Community Police program has shown great success in reducing crime rates. By recruiting and training trusted officers from within the local community, the program has been able to establish a strong presence in areas that were previously underserved by law enforcement. The program has also fostered better relationships between the police and the community they serve, improving cooperation and communication.

name: Order_Revolutionaries_Dangerous
title: Dangerous Revolutionary Threat
description: Revolutionary sentiments, fueled by influences from Valgsland, Morella, and United Contana, have escalated into a dangerous threat. Vigilant defenses are struggling to contain these groups, as their growing traction poses a serious risk to internal stability.

name: Order_Revolutionaries_Growing
title: Growing Revolutionary Threat
description: Influences from Valgsland, Morella, and United Contana are steadily nurturing revolutionary sentiments. Although their impact is not yet critical, these groups are gaining momentum, challenging Rizia's vigilant defenses and internal stability.

name: Order_Revolutionaries_NonThreat
title: No Revolutionary Threat
description: Influences from Valgsland, Morella, and United Contana spark revolutionary sentiments, but their overall impact remains negligible. Vigilant Rizian defenses and internal stability have ensured these foreign-influenced groups gain little traction.

name: Order_SecterianViolence
title: Secterian Religious Violence
description:
The kingdom is witnessing a high-severity surge in sectarian violence involving the Golcondist, Dastnurist, and Wruhecist communities, along with aggression towards other religious groups. These conflicts have led to widespread unrest and have posed significant challenges to national harmony. 

The government is urgently seeking to address this crisis, which threatens the fabric of Rizian society and the principles of religious tolerance and coexistence.

name: Order_SomeSecurityPowers
title: Limited Security Powers
description: The limitations of our police forces have unfortunately led to a higher rate of tragic crimes, but we are making efforts to improve the situation. Some suspected individuals who do not meet security criteria have been apprehended, which has contributed to a decrease in crime nationwide.

name: Order_StreamlinedImmigration
title: Streamlined Immigration
description: The latest immigration policy has made significant strides in addressing illegal immigration and streamlining legal immigration processes. The new policy has closed several loopholes that were previously exploited, leading to a reduction in the number of illegal immigrants. Additionally, the streamlined legal immigration processes have made it easier for those who want to immigrate to the country legally to do so.

name: Order_SubversivesArrested
title: Subversives Arrested
description: The Secret State Police conducted an operation and detained individuals suspected of subversion that threatened the integrity of Sordland. Their actions aimed to preserve the safety and stability of the nation. The State Police's efforts helped prevent potential harm to Sordland's citizens and institutions.

name: Order_SuOminaActivities_AlliedToCrown
title: Su Omina: Allied to Crown
description: Su Omina has expanded its influence across Rizia, upholding the "Rizia above all" mantra and aligning with the crown to reclaim historic territories. Their actions are confrontational against Wehzek, Derdian, and Morellan communities and involve patrols and rallies throughout the kingdom.

name: Order_SuOminaActivities_Destabilizing
title: Su Omina: Destabilizing Incitements
description: Su Omina now presents a severe threat with its aggressive nationalist agenda, challenging the crown and unsettling Rizia's social fabric. Their violent tactics disrupt communities, notably those with Wehzek, Derdian, and Morellan roots, causing deep strains in Rizia's stability and international reputation.

name: Order_SuOminaActivities_Increase
title: Su Omina: Activities Increase
description: Su Omina has bolstered its nationalist presence in Rizia, fervently pursuing the "Su Omina" mantra to restore ancient borders. Their activities, once non-violent and focused on neighborhood patrols and rallies in Iza, now aggressively target Wehzek, Derdian, and Morellan immigrants and asylum seekers.

name: Order_TelephoneTapping
title: Telephone Tapping
description: The Secret State Police of Sordland has been engaging in the interception of private communications without the knowledge or consent of citizens. The agents of SSP have been actively tapping into conversations held on phones and monitoring letters, claiming that it is necessary for security reasons.

name: Order_UnhappyPolicePersonnel
title: Dissatisfied Police Personnel
description: The decision to cut the budget of the Ministry of Interior has resulted in a significant decrease in the morale of the police personnel, who feel that they have been unfairly targeted by the government's cost-cutting measures. As a result, there has been an increase in the number of protests and demonstrations by police officers, demanding better pay, improved working conditions, and increased support from the government.

name: Order_ViolentProtests_Brenas
title: Violent Protest in Brenas Region
description: The Brenas Region, a key economic and cultural hub, is witnessing violent protests. These upheavals, driven by local dissatisfaction and increased immigrant influx, are challenging the authority of both House Sazon and the central government.

name: Order_ViolentProtests_CardesseMontaklar
title: Violent Protest in Cardesse-Montaklar Region
description: The industrial heartland of Cardesse-Montaklar is engulfed in violent protests. The region's blend of modern industry and cultural heritage is under threat as public discontent with local governance and economic policies escalates.

name: Order_ViolentProtests_NationalDestabilization
title: National Destabilization
description: Rizia is facing national destabilization, with violent protests erupting across all provinces. This widespread turmoil is shaking the very foundations of the nation, signaling a critical juncture in its history.

name: Order_ViolentProtests_ReligiousViolence
title: Widespread Religious Violence
description: The kingdom is witnessing widespread religious violence, with interfaith conflicts erupting in multiple regions. This surge in religiously motivated unrest is threatening the nation's long-standing harmony and stability.

name: Order_ViolentProtests_RiziaImperii
title: Violent Protest in Rizia Imperii
description: Rizia Imperii, encompassing Porte Drazon and Bronaz, is experiencing violent protests. These upheavals in the heart of Rizia's governance and economic power signify a critical loss of control and a deepening national crisis.

name: Order_ViolentProtests_Valenqiris
title: Violent Protest in Valenqiris
description: Valenqiris, a region pivotal to Rizia's economy, is facing violent protests. The unrest in this economically vital and culturally rich province is causing significant disruptions, reflecting a broader national crisis.

name: Order_ViolentSuppression
title: Violent Suppression of Emergency Targets
description: Recent collaborative efforts of the police forces with militant individuals has led to a stark decrease in the activities of the enemies of the state and other unwanted groups. According to reports, the operations conducted as part of this collaboration were swift and decisive, but increasingly violent due to the actions of the volunteering individuals.

name: Order_Wehlen_BludBan
title: Ban Only Bludish People from Border
description:
The implemented policy is banning solely Bludish individuals from entering Rizian territories. This act, seen as a direct response to a request from Wehlen is related to the escalating tensions with the BFF. 

It sparks international criticism and heightened ethnic tensions, raising concerns about discrimination and the potential for escalated conflict in the neighbouring regions.

name: Order_Wehlen_BludDerdianBan
title: Ban Both Bludish and Derdians from the Border
description: Escalating its security measures, Rizia has extended its entry ban to include both Bludish and Derdian people. This drastic policy, reflecting growing regional instability, has intensified diplomatic strains and incited widespread protests, underlining the severity of ethnic and geopolitical tensions in the region.

name: Order_WideRangingSecurityPowers
title: Wide-ranging Security Powers
description: Law enforcement authorities have been granted sweeping powers under the newly declared Emergency Decree, enabling them to exercise their authority with minimal restraint. The government insists that these measures are necessary to maintain law and order and protect the safety of the public.

name: Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied
title: Dissatisfied Wruhecist Community
description: The Wruhecist community, valuing 'curiosity' and 'skepticism' in their faith, expresses deep dissatisfaction. Their grievances stem from a perceived lack of recognition and support for their interpretive religious practices and Golconda philosophy.

name: Order_WruhecistCommunity_Happy
title: Happy Wruhecist Community
description: The Wruhecist community, following an interpretive approach to Nurity, enjoys a harmonious existence. Their inclusive practices and emphasis on Golconda are well-respected and supported, fostering a sense of fulfillment and belonging.

name: Order_WruhecistCommunity_Neutral
title: Neutral Wruhecist Community
description: The Wruhecist community maintains a neutral stance, practicing their faith with a focus on curiosity and skepticism. While there are minor issues regarding the expression of their beliefs, overall, the community coexists peacefully without major conflict or significant contentment.

name: Welfare_AddictionCrisis
title: Addiction Crisis
description: Addiction is spreading in society at rapid speeds. The people are suffering and are turning to the government for solutions.

name: Welfare_AlcoholConsumptionReduced
title: Alcohol Consumption Reduced
description: With the alcohol tax increased nationwide, the consumption and importation of alcoholic products have dropped significantly. This unexpected decrease in alcohol-related crime across the country has been welcomed by law enforcement and citizens alike.

name: Welfare_BrainDrain
title: Brain Drain
description: The lack of government focus on education and opportunities has caused many bright students to leave to other countries. This brain drain has had a negative impact on the country's intellectual capital and economy.

name: Welfare_ChildrenBenefits
title: Children Benefits
description: There has been a noticeable increase in the number of students across the country. Many families who previously struggled financially can now access financial assistance for their children's education and healthcare, enabling them to thrive. As a result of these initiatives, the literacy rate is expected to increase by 4% each year. Every child has access to quality education and healthcare, regardless of their financial situation.

name: Welfare_DastnuristWelfareAccess_Denied
title: Denial of Welfare Services for Dastnurists
description: The Dastnurist community faces a critical situation with the state denying them access to essential welfare services. This harsh exclusion exacerbates their vulnerabilities, deepening the divide between them and the rest of the society.

name: Welfare_DastnuristWelfareAccess_Restricted
title: Restriction of Welfare Services for Dastnurists
description: The Dastnurist community experiences restricted access to state welfare services. While not entirely excluded, these limitations pose significant challenges, affecting their quality of life and increasing social tensions.

name: Welfare_DastnuristWorshipPlaces_Overcrowded
title: Overcrowding at Dastnurist Places of Worship
description: The surging demand for Dastnurist sanctuaries in Rizia is palpable, with existing places of worship struggling with overcrowding. Devotees clamor for the construction of a new, expansive sanctuary to cater to the burgeoning congregation.

name: Welfare_DentalCare
title: Dental Care Programme
description: A new free dental care service has been implemented, allowing citizens to go to dentists and receive care without charge. This can help reduce the number of people suffering from dental problems and improve their overall quality of life.

name: Welfare_DisabilityBenefits
title: Disability Benefits
description: Many Sordish citizens are benefiting and surviving thanks to the disability benefits. Furthermore, dangerous jobs such as firefighting and law enforcement are being filled more frequently than before. This is partly due to the financial security provided by these benefits.

name: Welfare_EducationGap
title: Education Gap
description: The shift towards a privatized education system has raised concerns regarding its impact on the country's social and economic well-being. The privatization has led to a growing educational gap between the wealthy and less affluent members of society, as those with more financial resources are better able to access quality education. Furthermore, this gap could also create social instability as it perpetuates inequality and limits opportunities for social mobility.

name: Welfare_Education_Scholarship
title: Education Scholarship
description: The scholarship has helped many students to proceed with their studies to university. The financial cost required for studying at many universities in Sordland is quite substantial, and this scholarship has helped reduce the financial burden on students and their families. This initiative allows more individuals to access higher education and helps build a more educated and skilled workforce.

name: Welfare_Environmental_Protection
title: Environmental Protection Measures
description: The crown enforces new environmental safeguards across the Arufelde region, marking a pivotal effort to curb the ecological toll exacted by the Meftiem International Trade Zone’s (MITZ) aggressive economic footprint.

name: Welfare_EpidemicControlled
title: Epidemic Controlled
description: Due to the diligent efforts and timely precautions taken by the Ministry of Health, the epidemic that was spreading across the country is now under control. The ministry implemented a range of measures such as increased sanitation protocols, quarantine procedures, and public education campaigns to help prevent the spread of the disease. In addition to this, they also made efforts to increase the availability of medical resources and equipment, which has been crucial in the effective management of the epidemic.

name: Welfare_EpidemicPrevented
title: Epidemic Prevented
description: The Ministry of Health's prompt actions and effective measures have successfully prevented the epidemic from spreading, thereby averting a major health crisis in Sordland. Thanks to the ministry's strict implementation of protocols and guidelines, the country was able to contain the spread of the disease and keep the infection rates low. The tireless efforts of healthcare workers, including doctors, nurses, and medical staff, also played a crucial role in combating the epidemic.

name: Welfare_EpidemicSpreads
title: Epidemic Spreads
description: The Ministry of Health is facing a challenge as the epidemic that was previously contained in the city is now spreading outside its borders. Despite their efforts to control the situation, the virus is proving to be difficult to contain. The Ministry is working with other agencies and organizations to come up with new strategies to combat the outbreak and prevent further spread. The situation is being closely monitored and the government is taking necessary actions to ensure the safety and well-being of the citizens.

name: Welfare_EyeTests
title: Eye Tests for Public
description: The Ministry of Health has implemented a new program that provides free eye tests and subsidized glasses to all citizens in need. This initiative aims to improve access to eye care services and ensure that everyone can receive the necessary treatment without financial barriers. By providing these services, the Ministry of Health hopes to reduce the incidence of eye-related health issues and improve the overall quality of life for Sordish citizens. With the implementation of this program, more citizens are expected to seek eye care services and receive the necessary treatment, ultimately leading to better health outcomes for the population as a whole.

name: Welfare_FailedEducationReform
title: Failed Education Reform
description: The implementation of half-baked measures by the Ministry of Education has failed, causing disruption in the education system due to a lack of funds. The education sector plays a critical role in a country's social and economic development, and the negative effects of this failure are already being felt. The education system's inefficiencies have led to a significant decline in the quality of education, with a growing gap between those who can afford quality education and those who cannot.

name: Welfare_FreePublicTransport
title: Citizen Mobility Increased
description: Thanks to the implementation of a new law, the employment rate in Sordland has seen a significant surge. The law has enabled citizens from every corner of the country to commute to their work more easily, thus opening up more job opportunities for those who were previously unable to access them due to distance or transportation limitations. This has not only improved the overall employment rate but also contributed positively to the country's economy, as more people are now able to participate in the workforce and contribute to its growth.

name: Welfare_FundingDisruption
title: Funding Disruptions in Welfare
description: The ongoing economic crisis has posed a challenge for the government's efforts to sustain welfare programs. The budget constraints have impacted the efficiency of these programs, leading to a decline in the quality of services offered. This has become a pressing concern for many citizens who rely on these programs to meet their basic needs. The government is exploring alternative funding options and cost-cutting measures to ensure that these programs continue to operate effectively.

name: Welfare_GenderEqualityInEducation
title: Gender Equality In Education
description: The gender equality laws have had a significant impact on the education system, with a notable increase in the number of female students. However, despite the progress made, reports of discrimination among students persist across the country. It is clear that more needs to be done to ensure that students of all genders feel safe and supported in their academic environments. The government and educational institutions are working together to address this issue and provide resources for students who experience discrimination.

name: Welfare_GolcondistWelfareAccess_Denied
title: Denial of Welfare Services for Golcondists
description: The Golcondist community in Rizia is facing severe discrimination, with the state actively denying them access to essential welfare services. This blatant exclusion has deepened social rifts, pushing this marginalized group into dire straits and escalating societal tensions.

name: Welfare_GolcondistWelfareAccess_Restricted
title: Restriction of Welfare Services for Golcondists
description: The Golcondist population faces stark discrimination, with the state curbing their access to welfare services. This targeted exclusion deepens social divisions and exacerbates the vulnerabilities of this already marginalized group.

name: Welfare_GolcondistWorshipAccess_Denied
title: Denial of Access to Golcondist Places of Worship
description: In line with the Blasphemy Law, Golcondists find their religious freedoms severely curtailed. The state has clamped down on their places of worship, making practicing their faith a daunting challenge.

name: Welfare_GolcondistWorshipAccess_Restricted
title: Restriction of Access to Golcondist Places of Worship
description: Golcondists in Rizia experience significant challenges in practicing their faith, with the state imposing constraints on their places of worship. These restrictions are creating a sense of unease among the community, impacting their ability to freely engage in religious activities.

name: Welfare_GolcondistWorshipAccess_Unrestricted
title: Unrestricted Access to Golcondist Places of Worship
description: Golcondists in Rizia enjoy unhindered access to their places of worship. The state's relaxed approach allows them to practice their faith without significant interference, fostering a sense of religious liberty within the community.

name: Welfare_GoodUrbanInstitutions
title: Good Urban Institutions
description: To ensure the wellbeing of its citizens, Sordland has developed well-funded welfare institutions in its urban areas. These institutions are designed to provide support for those in need, including the elderly, disabled, and those experiencing financial difficulties. The government has made significant investments to ensure that these institutions are well-equipped and staffed with trained professionals who can provide the necessary assistance to those who require it.

name: Welfare_HappyEducationWorkers
title: Content Education Workers
description: The decision to increase the education budget has been met with positivity from the education sector. Teachers, principals, and other education workers are pleased with the government's prioritization of education and are showing increased support. The additional funding has allowed for improvements in school infrastructure, resources, and teaching quality, which will benefit students across the country. This investment in education is also expected to have positive long-term effects on the country's economy and social development.

name: Welfare_HappyHealthWorkers
title: Motivated Health Workers
description: The recent funding hike for health services has been well received by doctors, nurses and other health workers. This has had a positive impact on the morale of the health sector and increased their support for the government. The additional funds have also enabled the health services to improve the quality of care provided to patients, including the availability of necessary medical equipment and medications. As a result, patients across the country have reported an increase in the quality of their healthcare experience.

name: Welfare_HealthCrisis
title: Health Crisis
description: The health crisis in Sordland has worsened due to the underfunding and mismanagement of health services, resulting in a higher mortality rate, delayed care, and disorganization. The government has been criticized for not allocating enough funds to the health sector, leading to a lack of resources, overworked medical staff, and an inability to provide adequate care to patients. The situation has caused concern among citizens and healthcare workers, who have called for urgent action to address the crisis.

name: Welfare_HealthGap
title: Health Gap
description: The decision to privatize healthcare in Sordland has led to unequal access to medical services for different socioeconomic groups. While the wealthier communities can afford top-of-the-line medical care, those living in poverty are struggling to get even basic healthcare. This inequality in healthcare access can lead to negative long-term effects on the overall health of the country, and exacerbate the gap between the rich and the poor.

name: Welfare_Health_Scholarships
title: Scholarships for Health Education
description: The new health education scholarship initiative is providing thousands of students with unprecedented access to higher education opportunities. This program is aimed at increasing the number of healthcare professionals and improving the overall quality of healthcare in Sordland. The scholarships cover tuition, textbooks, and other related expenses for students pursuing healthcare degrees in various fields such as nursing, medicine, and dentistry. The program has received positive feedback from students and healthcare professionals alike, as it has opened up doors for many who previously could not afford to pursue their dreams.

name: Welfare_HousingAssistance
title: Homelessness Rate Reduced
description: The newly passed law has provided much-needed support to struggling middle and low-income families, resulting in a sharp decline in the number of homeless citizens on the streets. The law has provided various benefits such as financial assistance, housing subsidies, and job training programs to help those in need get back on their feet. The positive impact of the law has been significant, providing a ray of hope for many citizens who were previously struggling to make ends meet.

name: Welfare_Housing_FairHousingMarket
title: Fair Housing Market
description: The housing market showcases remarkable stability and fairness, marked by a variety of affordable housing options. Effective state policies have successfully balanced supply and demand, ensuring easy access to housing for a diverse population.

name: Welfare_Housing_LackOfAffordable
title: Lack of Affordable Housing
description: The housing market has become increasingly strained, leaving many citizens without access to reasonably-priced homes. Rapid urbanization and limited state intervention have exacerbated the housing deficit, forcing numerous families into precarious living conditions.

name: Welfare_Housing_WorseningCrisis
title: Worsening Housing Crisis
description: An acute housing crisis grips the nation, characterized by unaffordable prices and a dire shortage of reasonable housing options. This escalating problem has led to increased homelessness and significant distress among many citizens, impacting overall living standards.

name: Welfare_IllegalSubstanceAbuse_Average
title: Average Amount of Illegal Substance Abuse
description: Despite the state's efforts, illegal substance abuse remains at a moderate level in Rizia. While many citizens abstain, a noticeable portion of the population continues to grapple with addiction, drawing concerns from various societal sectors.

name: Welfare_IllegalSubstanceAbuse_High
title: High Amount of Illegal Substance Use
description: The kingdom is grappling with a significant substance abuse problem, with a large portion of the population battling addiction. This widespread issue is causing alarm across various societal sectors, indicating an escalating opioid crisis.

name: Welfare_IllegalSubstanceAbuse_Low
title: Low Amount of Illegal Substance Use
description: Illegal substance abuse is relatively contained, with a majority of the population abstaining from use. The incidence of addiction is low, reflecting effective state measures and societal awareness against substance abuse.

name: Welfare_ImprovedRuralSchools
title: Improved Rural Schools
description: The recent investments made towards rural schools have brought about a noticeable improvement in the quality of education offered. The classrooms have become larger and better equipped with modern teaching tools, which has greatly benefited students in these areas. This has helped to bridge the educational gap between urban and rural areas, making education more accessible to all. As a result of these improvements, more students are enrolling in rural schools, and the overall education standard in these areas is steadily increasing.

name: Welfare_ImprovedWorkingConditions
title: Improved Working Conditions
description: The Workers Rights Reform, which established a minimum wage, maximum weekly work hours, overtime pay, occupational hazard protection, and equal workers' rights for all, has brought several potential positive outcomes. By setting a minimum wage of 2.5 Sordish Ren per hour, low-income workers can earn a decent living, which can help reduce poverty and social inequality.

name: Welfare_InconsistentCurriculum
title: Inconsistent Curriculum
description: The varying opinions of different governments have resulted in a lack of consistency in the education system in Sordland. This inconsistency can lead to confusion among students, and they may receive an incomplete education. It can also impact the quality of education that students receive, as different curriculums may have different standards. This can lead to an educational gap between students who attend schools with different curriculums.

name: Welfare_IncreasedDepression
title: Increase of Depression
description: The recent implementation of tax increases and subsequent price hikes on certain products has had a negative impact on the mental health of the population. Reports indicate a significant increase in cases of psychological depression among citizens. This can have long-term effects on productivity and quality of life, and calls for measures to address the issue have been made.

name: Welfare_IronLungsForPolio
title: Polio Death Rate Curbed
description: The purchase of millions of iron lung health equipment has had a positive impact on the health of Sordland citizens affected by polio. Patients who require this type of equipment are now able to survive until medical professionals are able to provide them with the necessary treatment. As a result, the death rate of polio has significantly decreased, improving the overall health of the population.

name: Welfare_LackOfAccessRuralEducation
title: Inaccessible Rural Education
description: In rural areas of Sordland, the lack of accessibility to education has become a major issue. The distance between small villages and towns and the nearest schools makes it difficult for many children to attend school regularly. This has led to a significant disparity in educational opportunities between rural and urban areas, which can have long-term effects on the social and economic development of the country.

name: Welfare_LackOfQualityRuralHealthcare
title: Low Quality Rural Healthcare
description: The underdeveloped rural areas of Sordland have been facing major challenges in accessing quality healthcare services. The lack of basic hygiene and medical facilities has resulted in several illnesses and deaths, leading to a serious public health concern. The shortage of medical staff in these areas also adds to the challenges in providing prompt and efficient medical care to the residents.

name: Welfare_LivingStandards_Average
title: Average Living Standards
description: While aristocracy enjoys opulence, the average Rizian leads a moderate life. The majority of citizens have access to basic amenities, education, and healthcare, yet luxuries remain out of reach for many, painting a picture of middling prosperity.

name: Welfare_LivingStandards_Bad
title: Bad Living Standards
description: The living standards for the average Rizian have declined sharply, with many struggling to access even basic amenities. The stark contrast with the aristocracy's opulence highlights a growing divide, with education and healthcare becoming privileges rather than widespread rights.

name: Welfare_LivingStandards_Good
title: Good Living Standards
description:
The general populace enjoys a comfortable quality of life, with access to essential amenities and moderate luxuries. Basic needs like housing, healthcare, and education are well catered for, contributing to a stable and contented society. 

While some disparities exist, the gap between the aristocracy and the common citizen is not overly pronounced, allowing for a sense of shared prosperity and social harmony.

name: Welfare_LivingStandards_Great
title: Great Living Standards
description: Rizia's citizens enjoy high living standards, with widespread access to not just basic amenities but also various luxuries. This level of prosperity reflects a society where education, healthcare, and overall quality of life are well above average, bridging the gap between the aristocracy and the common populace.

name: Welfare_LivingStandards_Horrible
title: Horrible Living Standards
description:
The average citizen faces severe hardships, with living standards plummeting to alarming levels. Basic necessities such as adequate housing, clean water, and reliable food sources are increasingly out of reach for many. The disparity between the struggling majority and the affluent aristocracy is more pronounced than ever, with access to quality education and healthcare becoming a distant dream for most. 

This stark inequality exacerbates social tensions, painting a grim picture of a society deeply divided by wealth and privilege.

name: Welfare_LowerRetirementAge
title: New Jobs Opened For The Younger Generations
description: A demographic shift is occurring in Sordland as a substantial amount of the older population is retiring. This has led to a decrease in workplace accidents, as the aging workforce is replaced with younger, more physically able individuals. Additionally, new job positions are opening up for the younger generation, providing more opportunities for employment and economic growth.

name: Welfare_MedicalSchool
title: State of the Art Medical School
description: Under a new initiative, a new medical school has been established with advanced equipment and highly skilled professors. The state-of-the-art facilities and cutting-edge technology have attracted aspiring medical students from across the country, providing them with access to quality education and training. The medical school has also created job opportunities for medical professionals and staff, contributing to the growth of the healthcare sector in Sordland.

name: Welfare_ModernEducationTechniques
title: Modernized Education Techniques
description: The educational system in Sordland is undergoing significant reforms, with new education techniques being introduced and traditional teaching methods being curbed. The goal of the reforms is to improve the quality of education in the country, making it more relevant and effective for students. This has been achieved through the introduction of new technology and teaching methodologies, as well as the development of new curriculum and instructional materials. As a result of these changes, students are expected to have a more well-rounded education that will better prepare them for success in the workforce and in life.

name: Welfare_NewHospitals
title: New Hospitals
description: New hospitals have been established across Sordland, providing greater accessibility to health services for people in remote areas. This has helped in decreasing the mortality rate and improving the health condition of people in those areas. Furthermore, these hospitals are equipped with modern medical equipment and experienced healthcare professionals, providing quality medical care to patients in need.

name: Welfare_NewRuralSchools
title: Accessible Rural Education
description: With effective strategies implemented by the government, access to education in rural areas has significantly improved. Many students who previously had limited opportunities to learn are now able to attend school, thanks to various initiatives such as building new schools, increasing funding for education in rural areas, and providing transportation for students who live far from schools.

name: Welfare_OverburdenedWelfareSystem
title: Overburdened Welfare System
description: The welfare system in Sordland is currently facing significant challenges due to a variety of factors such as the lack of adequate funding and political mismanagement. As a result, the system is overburdened and struggling to provide essential services to those who need them the most. Many vulnerable individuals and families are finding it increasingly difficult to access the support they need to survive, let alone thrive. This has led to an increase in poverty, homelessness, and other related social issues.

name: Welfare_PaidStudentLoans
title: Student Loans Written Off
description: The recent government action of loan write-off has significantly impacted the financial well-being of lower-income families in Sordland. This initiative has lifted a massive financial burden off the shoulders of thousands of households and students who were struggling with debt. The loan write-off program has helped in reducing the overall debt level of the citizens, allowing them to redirect their funds towards necessary expenses such as food, shelter, and education.

name: Welfare_Polio_Contained
title: Sordish Polio Contained
description:
The successful containment of the polio outbreak, initially transmitted from Sordland, demonstrates the effectiveness of Rizia's healthcare system. Rapid response measures, including targeted vaccination campaigns and strict quarantine protocols, have been instrumental in halting the spread of the disease. 

This outcome is a testament to the resilience and preparedness of Rizia's public health infrastructure, safeguarding the well-being of its citizens.

name: Welfare_Polio_Spreads
title: Sordish Polio Spreads
description:
The escalation of the polio outbreak in Rizia, following its introduction from Sordland, has led to a critical public health crisis. The rapid spread of the disease has strained healthcare resources, causing widespread illness and increasing fatalities. 

This situation highlights the urgent need for enhanced medical interventions, public health measures, and community support to address the growing health emergency and mitigate its impact on the population.

name: Welfare_PublicTransportation_Overcrowded
title: Overcrowded Public Transportation
description: The public transportation network is increasingly overwhelmed, facing overcrowding across all modes of transit. This congestion is causing daily inconveniences for commuters, reflecting a growing challenge in maintaining efficient and comfortable travel for its citizens.

name: Welfare_QualityRuralHealthServices
title: Quality Rural Health Services
description: The quality of healthcare services in rural areas of Sordland has improved significantly, thanks to the recent government initiatives. Many medical facilities have been built, equipped with modern medical equipment and staffed with qualified healthcare professionals. As a result, people living in remote areas have greater access to medical care, reducing the need for long journeys to urban areas for medical treatment. The improvement in healthcare services is expected to have a positive impact on the overall health of rural communities, leading to a decrease in mortality rates and an increase in life expectancy.

name: Welfare_RelievedWelfareSystem
title: Relieved Welfare System
description: The welfare system has seen some successful improvements that have alleviated some of the strain caused by a lack of funds and political mismanagement. However, not all of the issues have been resolved, and the system is still facing challenges. While some lower-income families have been able to benefit from recent initiatives, there are still many who are struggling to access basic necessities and services.

name: Welfare_RelocationOfTeachersAndDoctors
title: Teachers and Doctors Relocated
description: The migration of a significant number of teachers and doctors to rural areas of Sordland has had a positive impact on the quality of education and healthcare in these regions. Although there has been some pushback and discontent among these professionals, the improvements in services in rural areas have already been noticed. This migration is expected to continue to improve access to essential services and opportunities for citizens living in rural areas.

name: Welfare_RizianHealthCrisis
title: Health Crisis
description: Years of neglected investment have left the kingdom’s health infrastructure fraying at the seams. The system buckles under relentless pressure, threatening the well-being of countless citizens and exposing deep cracks in the foundation of public health.

name: Welfare_RuralEducationInstitutes
title: Rural Education Institutes Opened
description: Access to education has improved significantly in Sordland with the opening of more schools and universities in the underdeveloped regions of the country. As a result, a growing number of citizens are now able to receive education, leading to a rapid increase in literacy rates in rural areas. This positive development is crucial in bridging the educational gap between urban and rural regions in the country, ultimately contributing to the overall growth and development of Sordland.

name: Welfare_Situation_FreeMedicine
title: Free Prescription Drugs
description: The implementation of the free prescription drugs law has brought about significant benefits for many of our poorer regions. Citizens who were previously unable to afford necessary medication are now able to receive it at no cost. This has resulted in improved health outcomes and increased productivity, as individuals are no longer forced to choose between paying for medication and meeting their other basic needs.

name: Welfare_SollistTeachings
title: Sollist Education
description: With schools and universities providing a solid understanding of our founding father, Tarquin Soll, students will be able to learn about the values, principles, and history that shaped our country. Through this education, they can develop a deep appreciation for their heritage and a sense of pride in their nation. Moreover, by understanding the struggles and sacrifices made by our founding father, students can develop a sense of responsibility towards their country and become informed and active citizens who work towards the betterment of their society.

name: Welfare_State_Average
title: Average Welfare State
description: The welfare system offers some safety net for its citizens, with very limited access to health, education, and unemployment benefits. The state's lack of commitment to public welfare is reflected negatively in the society.

name: Welfare_State_Good
title: Good Welfare State
description: The welfare system provides a good safety net for its citizens, ensuring health, education, and unemployment benefits are widely accessible. The state's dedication to public welfare is evident in its substantial budget allocations, fostering a sense of security among its populace.

name: Welfare_State_Strong
title: Strong Welfare State
description: The comprehensive welfare system provides a robust safety net for its citizens, ensuring health, education, and unemployment benefits are widely accessible. The state's dedication to public welfare is evident in its substantial budget allocations, fostering a sense of security among its populace.

name: Welfare_TobaccoConsumptionReduced
title: Tobacco Consumption Reduced
description: The nationwide increase in tobacco tax has shown to have a positive impact on public health. The decrease in consumption and importation of tobacco products has resulted in a significant decrease in the number of lung-related sickness and birth defects reported across Sordland. This is an unexpected yet welcome outcome of the implementation of the new tobacco tax. The government's efforts to promote a healthier lifestyle for its citizens are likely to continue in the future as more measures are taken to improve public health.

name: Welfare_UnemploymentWage
title: Unemployment Wages Benefits
description: The government's decision to provide unemployment wages has brought relief to many citizens who were previously struggling to make ends meet. This initiative has allowed these individuals to have the financial stability they need to search for suitable job opportunities, instead of having to settle for any low-paying job just to survive. As a result of this initiative, there has been a decrease in the number of low-pay jobs across the country. This has resulted in a better standard of living for many citizens who were previously stuck in a cycle of poverty.

name: Welfare_WorkersRights_Acceptable
title: Acceptable Workers Rights
description: Labor rights in the kingdom strike a balance between industry needs and worker welfare. Reasonable work hours, proper safety measures, and fair representation are widespread, leading to a generally contented workforce.

name: Welfare_WorkersRights_Bad
title: Bad Workers Rights
description: Laborers across Rizia face an uphill battle for their rights. Exploitative work hours, lack of proper safety measures, and minimal representation have become widespread issues, causing unrest in various industrial sectors.

name: Welfare_WorkersRights_Good
title: Good Workers Rights
description: Workers in Rizia generally enjoy acceptable working conditions, with fair hours, adequate safety measures, and sufficient representation. This positive labor environment contributes to minimal unrest in the industrial sectors.

name: Welfare_WorkersRights_Horrible
title: Horrible Workers Rights
description: The kingdom faces a critical situation regarding labor rights, with rampant exploitation, inadequate safety, and poor representation. This has led to widespread unrest and dissatisfaction among workers across various sectors.
